title: How Adam Robinson grew LinkedIn to 140k followers and RB2B to $4M ARR with a six-step framework
summary: Adam Robinson breaks down his LinkedIn playbook: define a clear, consistent character, take polarizing and vulnerable positions, optimize your profile, write hook-driven posts, run patient connect campaigns, and build community through comments. He credits it with 140k followers in 2 years and RB2B reaching $4M ARR from LinkedIn alone.

principles.text: Build a personal character with three Cs: be clear, be consistent, and constantly reinforce it.
principles.quote: You must be incredibly clear about who you are. The market knows me. Adam Robinson is a bootstrapped SAS founder who builds in public with radical transparency.

principles.text: Live in the prolific zone: polarizing takes between mainstream noise and crazy; being loved by 80% and hated by 20% is fine.
principles.quote: If you're far enough out to the right where 80% of the people on the right are going to love you and 20% of the people on the left are going to absolutely hate you, that's a great place to live.

principles.text: Vulnerability is an unfair advantage small players have; big companies can't be candid about real problems.
principles.quote: If you can say things on LinkedIn that you might only say to your spouse behind closed doors, it will do better than anything any larger company could ever post.

principles.text: Write for the audience, not the algorithm; the algorithm serves the audience, so better content is the only durable fix.
principles.quote: You are not writing for an algorithm. You're writing for an audience.

principles.text: Hooks should build maximum credibility fast, assume no one knows you, and use numbers, since the hook's only job is getting the 'see more' click.
principles.quote: Always write like no one's ever heard of you before and try to build the most credibility possible because most people seeing your post don't have any idea who you are.

principles.text: Be patient after connecting: wait about 60 days of content exposure before messaging, which yields an 80% reply rate.
principles.quote: After 60 days of seeing your content and possibly even engaging with it, this person thinks you're a celebrity. Once you reach out to them, when they've been reading your stuff, there's an 80% reply rate.
